plan.purpose: Race verification of every cross-CTA exchange (Triton L2 counter barrier forward and backward, TileLang cluster DSMEM bulk copies with mbarriers, TileLang cooperative-grid exchange) with compile-time content checks, seeded producer/consumer delays and broken-variant negative controls; plus the two-warpgroup cluster kernel as a positive control
plan.rule: correct: zero violations and bitwise equal to the uninstrumented reference in all 21 runs; broken variant (own process): violations in >= 80% of its completed runs (>= 1) and no completed run with a differing output but zero violations; runs after a CUDA-context corruption count as crashed; no_sync reported only; delays 0-65 us

expected_minutes.basis: about six TileLang compiles (30-60 s) or four Triton compiles per task, 85 short runs per task; 18 tasks on four lanes

plan.node_reason: One H100 node (4 H100): independent single-GPU lanes
